stories.title: Death toll from Colombia earthquake continues to rise
stories.summary: The death toll from a devastating earthquake that flattened dozens of buildings in western Colombia jumped to 224, local authorities said on Tuesday (August 11) as emergency workers dug through the wreckage for survivors. FRANCE 24's Maria Clara Calle Aguirre tells us more.
stories.post: 📰 NEWS: Death toll from Colombia earthquake continues to rise. The death toll from a devastating earthquake that flattened dozens of buildings in western Colombia jumped to 224, local authorities said on Tuesday (August 11) as emergency workers dug. Source: France 24.
stories.headline: Death toll from Colombia earthquake continues to rise

opening: The death toll from a devastating earthquake that flattened dozens of buildings in western Colombia jumped to 224, local authorities said on Tuesday (August 11) as emergency workers dug through the wreckage for survivors.
FRANCE 24's Maria Clara Calle Aguirre tells us more.
body: At least 224 people have been killed in Colombia following a 7.4 magnitude earthquake which struck the western part of the country.
With thousands of people still missing, authorities are warning the number of casualties could continue to climb.

stories.title: South Africa hit by icy blast as snow blankets several provinces
stories.summary: A bitter cold snap is sweeping across South Africa, bringing heavy snow, freezing temperatures and strong winds to several provinces. Snow has covered high-lying areas while forecasters warn of more wintry weather and rough seas along the coast.

stories.title: Disrupted monsoons force India to face climate threat
stories.summary: For generations, India has lived by the rhythm of the southwest monsoon. But with the country hit by dry spells, cloudbursts and deadly floods, climate swings now expose the costs of building for yesterday's weather.

stories.summary: Paris is preparing for the solar eclipse. The last one here in France was in 1999. So this is one not to miss, especially for the astrophotographer we met.
